lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: The Tooth Fairy. Peppa and George are having their favorite food: spaghetti.
lines.zh: 牙仙。佩奇和乔治在吃他们最喜欢的食物：意大利面。

lines.en: What a lot of noise!
lines.zh: 好吵啊！

lines.en: Finished. Ah, now we'll have a bit of quiet.
lines.zh: 吃完了。啊，现在总算能安静一会儿了。

lines.en: What's that? It's a tooth. Where did that come from, Peppa? Maybe you should look in the mirror.
lines.zh: 那是什么？是一颗牙。佩奇，它是从哪儿来的？也许你该照照镜子。

lines.en: Oh, it's my tooth. It's falling out.
lines.zh: 哦，是我的牙。它要掉了。

lines.en: Don't worry, Peppa. It's just a milk tooth. They're meant to fall out. Will I grow a new one, Mummy? Yes, you will, Peppa. It also means the Tooth Fairy will be paying you a visit.
lines.zh: 别担心，佩奇。这只是乳牙。乳牙本来就是要掉的。妈妈，我还会长新牙吗？会的，佩奇。这也意味着牙仙会来看你哦。

lines.en: Tooth Fairy? Yes, the Tooth Fairy. If you put the tooth under your pillow tonight, the Tooth Fairy will come.
lines.zh: 牙仙？是的，牙仙。如果你今晚把牙齿放在枕头底下，牙仙就会来。

lines.en: The Tooth Fairy will take the tooth, and in its place she will leave a shiny coin.
lines.zh: 牙仙会把牙齿带走，然后在原来的地方留下一枚亮闪闪的硬币。

lines.en: When I grow up, I want to be a Tooth Fairy. Oh, and what would you like to be when you grow up, George?
lines.zh: 我长大了想当牙仙。哦，那乔治你长大了想当什么？

lines.en: Dinosaur. A dinosaur?
lines.zh: 恐龙。恐龙？

lines.en: Quick, George, it's bedtime. We don't want to miss the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 快点，乔治，该睡觉了。我们可不想错过牙仙。

lines.en: Before going to bed, Peppa and George brush their teeth. Peppa, what are you doing? I'm brushing my tooth so it's nice and clean for the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 睡觉前，佩奇和乔治在刷牙。佩奇，你在做什么？我在刷我的牙，好让它干干净净地给牙仙。

lines.en: Peppa cannot wait to get into bed. Peppa is putting her tooth under the pillow for the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 佩奇迫不及待要上床了。佩奇把牙齿放在枕头底下，等着牙仙来拿。

lines.en: Good night, Peppa and George. Good night, Mummy. Good night, Daddy. Good night, my little piggies.
lines.zh: 晚安，佩奇和乔治。晚安，妈妈。晚安，爸爸。晚安，我的小猪们。

lines.en: George, I'm not going to sleep. Let's both stay awake all night and see the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 乔治，我不睡觉了。我们两个整晚都别睡，看看牙仙长什么样。

lines.en: This Tooth Fairy is very late. The Tooth Fairy is taking a long, long time to arrive. Where is that Tooth Fairy?
lines.zh: 这个牙仙来得真晚。牙仙花了好久好久才到。那个牙仙到底在哪儿？

lines.en: What is that noise? Is it the Tooth Fairy? George, can you hear something?
lines.zh: 那是什么声音？是牙仙吗？乔治，你听到什么了吗？

lines.en: Oh, George! Oh, the noise is George. He was so tired, he has fallen asleep.
lines.zh: 哦，乔治！哦，原来是乔治的声音。他太累了，已经睡着了。

lines.en: George is not very good at staying awake. But I am. I'm going to stay awake and see the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 乔治不太擅长熬夜。不过我可以。我要一直醒着，看看牙仙。

lines.en: I'm not going to sleep.
lines.zh: 我不会睡着的。

lines.en: The Tooth Fairy has arrived, but Peppa is asleep. Hello, Peppa. Would you like this coin in return for your tooth?
lines.zh: 牙仙来了，可佩奇睡着了。你好，佩奇。你愿意用这颗牙换这枚硬币吗？

lines.en: What a nice clean tooth. Thank you, Peppa. Good night.
lines.zh: 多干净的一颗牙呀。谢谢你，佩奇。晚安。

lines.en: Peppa! George! Wake up! It's morning!
lines.zh: 佩奇！乔治！醒醒！天亮啦！

lines.en: What? I wasn't asleep. Did the Tooth Fairy come?
lines.zh: 什么？我没睡着。牙仙来过了吗？

lines.en: No. Let's take a look at your pillow. Oh, look, Peppa, the Tooth Fairy has been, and she's left you a coin.
lines.zh: 没有呀。我们看看你的枕头吧。哦，看，佩奇，牙仙来过了，她给你留了一枚硬币。

lines.en: Hooray! You fell asleep, didn't you? Well, maybe I fell asleep just for a little bit.
lines.zh: 太好啦！你睡着了吧？嗯，也许我就睡了一小会儿。

lines.en: Next time I will stay awake, and I will see the Tooth Fairy.
lines.zh: 下次我一定不睡，我要亲眼看看牙仙。
